title: Yieldo
tagline: Find Better Yield. Curated vaults + risk signals. One-tap deposits across chains.
description:
Yieldo helps users find better yield and deposit with confidence.

We aggregate vault platforms, analyze data to create advanced metrics and risk signals, and show who’s allocating (ENS/whale activity) so users can truly understand the risks and rewards of different strategies.

These data-driven metrics and risk flags are crucial for curation and integration by wallets and portfolio apps, unlocking higher yield for their users and new distribution channels for curators.

Our DepositRouter powers cross-chain deposits via LI.FI, with on-chain attribution built into the deposit path so integrations (wallets/apps/KOLs) can track and monetize AUM-time cleanly.

In the end, curators can use this to run data-driven campaigns to promote their strategies and share their revenue with distributors and end users.
how_its_made:
Built around a DepositRouter contract that fixes attribution by paying channels on outcomes (AUM time) instead of impressions. Uses EIP-712 typed signatures for deposit intents, enabling an SDK where distributors (wallets, portfolio apps, KOLs) can integrate deposits while maintaining referrer attribution.
The referral system splits fees 50/50 between referrer and protocol, with ENS support for human-readable referrer addresses. This lets channels track and get paid for deposits they drive.
Cross-chain deposits via LI.FI contract calls enable single-transaction deposits from any chain to any vault (swap → bridge → deposit), removing friction and network switching.
A composite scoring system aggregates on-chain metrics (TVL, APY, risk flags) with user behavior analytics (retention, holding periods) to provide data insights for curation, helping distributors surface high-quality vaults.
Partner technologies:
LI.FI: Cross-chain routing via contract calls, enabling frictionless deposits from any chain
ENS: Human-readable referrer addresses for better UX and attribution

The DepositRouter SDK allows any distributor to integrate deposits while maintaining referrer attribution. The scoring system combines on-chain fundamentals with user trust signals (retention rates, farming detection) to surface vaults that attract long-term holders, not just high APY chasers.
